metadata.title: Why Micron Stock Is Jumping Ahead of Google Earnings<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Micron Stock Is Jumping Ahead of Google Earnings
Micron Technology and SK Hynix shares were climbing early Tuesday ahead of Big Tech earnings which kick off with an update from Google-parent Alphabet Wednesday.
